title: CadYam · Design by describing it to AI
excerpt: CadYam is a design app for homes, gardens, clothes, 3D prints and videos, in 2D and 3D. Describe what you want and your AI assistant draws it. Free for now, for macOS, Windows and Linux.
content_html:
CadYam

Design homes,gardens,clothes,furniture,3D prints,videos,data stories,
just by describing them to AI.

No technical skills needed. Precise like CAD, easy like a conversation.

Free for now. The latest version for macOS, Windows and Linux.
